# Fusion Media Creative Agency

> Senior brand, creative and communications, without the agency layers. Dave Paull makes businesses, products and technology easier to understand, and harder to ignore. Based in Burleigh Heads, Gold Coast, Australia, working with clients across Australia and overseas.

Fusion Media is led by Dave Paull, a creative director and commercial photographer with more than twenty years of brand, campaign and launch work for theme parks, plant science, health and technology companies. Clients are founders and established businesses with something valuable that is not being understood. Clients deal with Dave directly; he leads the thinking, makes the work, and brings in a trusted specialist network when a project needs it, including James Yau (strategy and operations) and David Place (capital and transactions) of JYCO Partners.

## Services: Position, Present, Launch

- [Position](https://fusionmedia.wtf/services/#position): What you are, who it is for, and why it matters. Strategy and market positioning; The sentence that carries it, and the messaging built from it; Narrative for customers, partners and investors; Pitch story for a raise or a relaunch.
- [Present](https://fusionmedia.wtf/services/#present): How the business looks and sounds wherever someone meets it. Brand, visual identity, guidelines and packaging; Photography and art direction, from one product to a full crew; Film, explainers and animation; Websites and online stores, designed and built.
- [Launch](https://fusionmedia.wtf/services/#launch): The work that puts it in front of the right people, and helps close the sale. Campaigns and launch artwork for outdoor, print, screens and social; Sales material: decks, sell sheets, brochures and one pagers; Email, microsites and digital campaigns; Live activations and events.
- [For founders and technology companies](https://fusionmedia.wtf/founders/): Positioning, narrative, pitch, website, demonstration and launch for technology that is harder to explain than it should be.

## Results

- 400% sales increase in the first month after the Aptus relaunch.
- $10M raised by Pellucid, with the investor film and pitch deck Dave made.
- 30+ food and drink venues rebranded for Village Roadshow Theme Parks.
- 200+ campaigns art directed and shot across six theme parks.

## Case studies

- [Aptus: The best product in its market, behind a brand that hid it.](https://fusionmedia.wtf/work/aptus/) Result: Sales up 400% in the first month, with the store live in Australia, New Zealand, the United States and Canada.
- [Leafio: A brand rebuilt to work under strict advertising rules.](https://fusionmedia.wtf/work/leafio/) Result: Publication print run up from 1,000 to 5,000. An average visit of 5 minutes 9 seconds on the lead generation microsite. More than 200 emails sent through the new system.
- [Natural Beauty: Launching into a crowded shelf.](https://fusionmedia.wtf/work/natural-beauty/) Result: A range that reads as one family at a glance, eighteen months of content from two days on set, and a store built to keep customers, not just win them.
- [Pellucid: An industry investors did not understand.](https://fusionmedia.wtf/work/pellucid/) Result: Investors understood the industry before the first meeting. The company raised $10M.
- [Riper: A supply chain idea nobody could picture.](https://fusionmedia.wtf/work/riper/) Result: The whole business understood in ninety seconds, on a phone, without a founder in the room.
- [Village Roadshow Theme Parks: From a pencil sketch to a billboard.](https://fusionmedia.wtf/work/village-roadshow/) Result: 200+ campaigns across six parks, 30+ venues rebranded, and the external agencies replaced.
- [Character and illustration: Characters people remember.](https://fusionmedia.wtf/work/characters/) Result: Distinctive characters that made each campaign instantly recognisable, and one that became a collection of more than 10,000.
